title: Asiad: World champ Custodio bows out in rough start for PH jiu-jitsu
summary: The Philippines' jiu-jitsu campaign in the 2026 Asian Games got off to a rough start on Thursday, with world champion jiu-jitsu Kimberly Custodio making an early exit.
